lines: Robinson is on IR after a practice setback, and the coach said he will miss time. He has played 6 of ATL's 10 games.
In his last 3 games he played 27% of snaps and averaged 7.7 carries, down from 8.8 carries a game on the season.
He scored 10.1 PPR points a game over those 3 games, up from 8.8 on the season, with 2.3 red zone carries and targets a game.
